final_prompt:
Write the text of an Ujjwal Rail official rule document.
Document: RUL-CAN-01 "Cancellation and refunds" (effective from 2025-04-01). Language: English.
Write each section below as 1-4 clear sentences for passengers, using ONLY the facts given.
Keep every number, amount, percentage, time, date and document ID exactly as given, using Western
digits (0-9) even in Hindi. Write dates in the YYYY-MM-DD form given. Do not add any other numbers,
rules, phone numbers, websites or contact details.
Sections (name: facts):
- "1. How to cancel": Cancel through the app, website or assistant up to departure. Partial cancellation of some travellers is allowed.
- "2. Departure time used": All time limits are counted from the scheduled departure time of the train from the passenger's boarding station.
- "3. Refund table": Per confirmed or RAC passenger. More than 48 hours before departure: flat charge (SL Rs 120, 3A Rs 180, 2A Rs 240, 1A Rs 300, CC Rs 90). More than 12 and up to 48 hours: 25% of the fare, but not less than the flat charge. More than 4 and up to 12 hours: 50% of the fare, but not less than the flat charge. 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart): no refund. 'More than N hours' is strict: cancelling exactly N hours before departure falls in the next, costlier band.
- "4. Waitlisted and RAC tickets": A waitlisted passenger who cancels, or whose ticket stays waitlisted after the chart, gets a full refund minus a clerkage charge of Rs 60 per passenger. RAC passengers follow the refund table.
- "5. Refund processing": Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 working days.
Schema: {"sections": [{"section": "<exact section name>", "text": str}]}

sections.text: Cancel through the app, website or assistant up to departure. Partial cancellation of some travellers is allowed.
All time limits are counted from the scheduled departure time of the train from the passenger's boarding station.

For confirmed or RAC passengers, cancellations more than 48 hours before departure incur a flat charge of Rs 120 for SL, Rs 180 for 3A, Rs 240 for 2A, Rs 300 for 1A and Rs 90 for CC. Cancellations more than 12 hours and up to 48 hours before departure are charged 25% of the fare, but not less than the applicable flat charge. Cancellations more than 4 hours and up to 12 hours before departure are charged 50% of the fare, but not less than the applicable flat charge, and cancellations 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart) receive no refund. Cancelling exactly at the hour limit falls in the next, costlier band.
A waitlisted passenger who cancels, or whose ticket remains waitlisted after the chart, receives a full refund minus a clerkage charge of Rs 60 per passenger. RAC passengers follow the refund table.
Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 7 working days.
